title: Blood Falls | 100 Wonders | Atlas Obscura
description:
One of the great weird natural wonders in the world, it's a five story blood red waterfall in Antartica and its full of novel extremophiles! What's not to love! Subscribe for new videos every Tues & Thurs - http://bit.ly/1PcJ14b
